speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Residents can also take the many feeder services available to transfer to one of the bus services mentioned.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: One is, has the Ministry conducted any assessment on the ridership patterns and bus route surveys for the route between Geylang Serai area and Bedok?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: The second question is this: I thank the Senior Minister of State again for the elaboration on the bus routes but certainly, there are certain areas in Bedok North and Bedok South where the residents will require to take feeder transfers.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: We receive quite some feedback from residents in Bedok complaining about the waiting time for both the feeder services as well as for the main transfer from New Upper Changi Road or from Bedok Interchange.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: For a relatively short distance between Bedok and Geylang Serai, there is a lot of waiting and transfer time.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Especially for residents during the Hari Raya period, when they have to carry a lot of purchases on their way back, this can become rather inconvenient and cumbersome.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Mr Dennis Tan, could you summarise your supplementary question?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: Yes, there is a precedent of Chinatown Direct services.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: For example, there is the Chinese New Year service from Clementi to Chinatown, plus two other direct services that run round the year.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: So, there is precedent for such a service.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: Would the Senior Minister of State consider having such a service, especially during Hari Raya?

speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
text: As the Member has mentioned, there is, indeed, a Clementi-Chinatown Direct service during the festive period.
